candidates.label: 自然な写真
candidates.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: LocalVoice travel audio guide app home banner candidate. Landscape rectangle exactly 1774x887 pixels, 2:1 aspect ratio, full bleed opaque, no border or rounded corners. Readable at 350x175px mobile display. No text, lettering, labels, branding or watermark. Travel and listening theme. Prioritize coherent art direction, limited visual elements, believable construction and relaxed asymmetry. No glossy 3D, no glowing lighting, no generic stock AI illustration aesthetic. Create a restrained editorial travel photograph: a slightly worn folded unlabelled street map and a realistic compact pair of dark green wired earphones resting naturally on a sun-faded wooden bench beside a quiet seaside town. Distant modest buildings and sea softly out of focus; no people. Soft ordinary overcast daylight, subdued colors, fine natural film grain, imperfect paper folds and weathered wood. Camera at seated eye height, 50mm lens, realistic scale, plausible earphones with two simple earbud pieces and a single gently curved cord, no extra parts. Unstaged ordinary atmosphere, no dramatic mountains, no fantasy architecture, no oversaturated postcard view. Keep the entire map and earphones away from frame edges. This is a photograph, not watercolor or drawing.

candidates.label: 鉛筆と淡彩・街歩き
candidates.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: LocalVoice app home banner, exactly 1774x887 pixels, full-bleed opaque 2:1 landscape.
Input images: Image 1 is the preferred pencil-and-light-wash technique and mood; image 2 is the existing home banner subject vocabulary; image 3 is existing login scenery and color reference; image 4 is the existing folded-map icon shape and colors; image 5 is brand color reference ONLY, do not draw or paste the logo.
Primary request: Create a revised candidate that keeps the human graphite pencil plus selective pale watercolor quality of image 1, while clearly belonging to the same app visual family as images 2-5. Palette MUST be dominated by deep teal green #075747, sage #739C85, light mint greens, and very light warm ivory #FBFAF5; secondary muted pale blue water, small warm cream and sandy touches. Replace the all-over yellow/sepia cast and black/grey dominance of image 1 with cleaner ivory paper and green-tinted pencil contours, while retaining authentic irregular pencil marks, broken edges, varied line pressure and areas of untouched paper. The map must visually echo image 4's three-panel folded map with cream road lines, mint/sage regions and deep green boundary; dark green wired earphones echo image 2. Avoid dense cross-hatching, uniform thick cartoon outlines, oversaturated greens, glossy vector surfaces and artificial vignette. Keep all main foreground objects inside the frame, legible at 350x175 pixels. No words, symbols, lettering, label, logo, watermark, border or UI.
Composition: Preserve image 1's inviting ordinary neighborhood street leading toward distant pale blue water, modest houses and a leafy tree, and the foreground folded map with two earbud pieces on a low wall. Keep the sketchbook feeling and perspective. Recolor the foliage, window shutters, earphones and pencil contours in the app greens. Use muted cream house walls, pale clean ivory open sky and understated sage tree washes. Make the graphite observations feel light and relaxed rather than fully rendered. Reduce tiny scenery detail so the map and earphones read clearly.
